claude.performance_metric: merger integration costs declined $826M (2015) to $273M (2017); FY2017 net income $1,919M
claude.rationale: p4=1: the filing documents that operational-systems integration was still incomplete four years post-close ("several additional important system integration projects" remained) and explicitly flagged that such integrations "taken longer, been more disruptive and cost more than originally forecast," evidencing realized product/process-interface disruption, with material merger-integration IT costs still charged in 2017. p5=1: the filing documents an unresolved labor/organization interface, with a named maintenance/fleet workgroup still under separate legacy collective bargaining agreements not amendable until Q3 2018, more than four years after closing, and joint-contract negotiations proceeding outside the ordinary process. t2 coded 0 as no incompatibility of value-capture logics is documented; t1 uncertain as the slice contains no evidence about the controlling-intent archetype as it played out.

gemini.performance_metric: sustained profitability and revenue in the low-$40-billion range each year
gemini.rationale: The slice documents ongoing integration costs and incomplete systems integration, but does not report realized disruption or failure at the product/process interface (p4 = 0). Similarly, while some labor groups remained under legacy contracts, the slice explicitly notes that no work stoppages or self-help occurred, indicating no realized fracture at the process/organization interface (p5 = 0).

grok.performance_metric: sustained profitability FY2015-17; no GW impairment; integration costs $826M→$273M
grok.rationale: p4 is 0 because the FY2017 10-K reports that key systems (customer reservations; pilot/fleet scheduling) had been successfully integrated, with remaining projects still incomplete and only a forward-looking risk citing disruptiveness in prior industry mergers—not a realized product/process incoherence on this deal. p5 is 0 because, although one labor workgroup remained on separate legacy CBAs pending a 2018 amendability date, joint CBAs had been reached with other groups and the filing documents no work stoppage or organizational fracture.
